about: Application colours. scripts/colors.mjs generates frontend/src/colors.generated.{css,ts}, the startup style in frontend/index.html and ground() in colors_generated.go from this file; run `pnpm colors:generate` in frontend after editing it. A token is one colour, or a light and a dark value.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window ground behind the panels, the startup background before the page paints, the native window background (ground() in Go) and Ant Design's colorBgLayout.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panels, title bars, sidebars and setting cards.

tokens.name: head
tokens.usage: Column header of the cue grid and the timeline ruler.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, hints, metadata and inactive sidebar items.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: 1 px hairlines: panel, card and title-bar borders. Decorative, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: select
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered rows, sidebar items and window-control hover.

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Subtitle blocks on the timeline and dictionary previews.

tokens.name: wave
tokens.usage: Waveform outside the selected range (read by Timeline.tsx).

tokens.name: wave-sel
tokens.usage: Waveform inside the selected range (read by Timeline.tsx).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand blue: Ant Design's colorPrimary, focus rings, the playhead and selected cues.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: 1 px outline of frameless windows outside macOS.

tokens.name: scroll-thumb-hover
tokens.usage: Scrollbar and timeline zoom thumbs while hovered or dragged.

tokens.name: video-ground
tokens.usage: Letterbox behind the video in both themes.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Ant Design's colorError seed. Light reaches 4.5:1; the dark algorithm turns the dark seed into #dc6966.

tokens.name: tag-green-text
tokens.usage: Green tag text. The light value overrides Ant Design's green7 to reach 4.5:1; dark keeps Ant Design's own.

tokens.name: tag-orange-text
tokens.usage: Orange tag text. The light value overrides Ant Design's orange7 to reach 4.5:1; dark keeps Ant Design's own.

tokens.name: tag-gold-text
tokens.usage: Gold tag text. The light value overrides Ant Design's gold7 to reach 4.5:1; dark keeps Ant Design's own.
